- **Dead paths:** if edge 0 is none, node 1 gets no signal, so edits to edges 2 and 4 matter less.
- **Replacement effects:** the same edit gains more when it replaces none than when it replaces a conv, and loses more when it replaces a conv.
- **Redundancy:** parallel convs into the same node show diminishing returns.
